violations.msg: 5V input J1 has no polarity legend on silk (refdes only; pin-1 dot is covered by the header body after assembly). requirements.md sec 2 and blocks.md promise 'polarity marked on silkscreen'. Consequence: unkeyed input plugged backwards gives a dead board with no on-board hint (D1 prevents damage but not confusion). Fix: add '5V'/'GND' (or +/-) silk text outside the header body.

SWD header J2 pin functions unlabeled; blocks.md promises 'silk-labeled' canonical order (1=SWDIO 2=SWCLK 3=3V3 4=GND, electrically verified correct). Pin-1 square cell is covered by the header body after assembly. Consequence: pin-by-pin ST-Link hookup from memory; a 3V3/GND swap shorts the debugger rail. Fix: four silk texts below the header row (area is clear).

Refdes association ambiguous: 'C11' text sits over R1's body, 'C1' below-left of R1, C7/C8 labels float between parts; 'C3' text renders directly under J2 pads 3-4 and reads like a header label. Cluster mixes 22pF/10nF/100nF/1uF 0603s, so silk-guided rework can land on the wrong part. Assembly is CPL-driven (no production risk). Waiver acceptable for rev A; nudging labels is free if the J1/J2 silk edit happens anyway.

BOM of record drift: parts.json lists 100nF (C14663) qty_per_board=5 with role 'C1-C3 VDD + C4 VDDA 100nF, C9 NRST', but the board mounts 4 (C1,C2,C3,C9); C4 is now 1uF (C15849) and C10 10nF (C57112) per the VDDA-pair fix, and those entries carry no refdes. P9 quoting/ordering from parts.json over-counts one line and cannot map two refdes. Fix qty and role strings before ordering.
